sentences.text: The petitioner is facing trial in C.C.No.1808 of 2019 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Theni for the offences under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Non bailable warrant has been issued against the petitioner.
The petitioner is ready to appear before the trial Magistrate.

However, he is apprehensive that the recall petition may not considered on the same day and as a result, he may be remanded to custody.
2.I was inclined to allow the application straightaway.

But then, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor pointed out that on account of the non-appearance of the petitioner before the trial Magistrate, Mr.A.Shanmugam, Food Safety Officer, Allinagarm, Theni, had to go all the way to Haryana along with four other police personnel to secure the petitioner herein.
He had to spend a sum of Rs.25,000/-.
I made it clear to the petitioner's counsel that unless the said amount is reimbursed, I will not be inclined to grant any relief to the petitioner herein.

The petitioner's counsel on instructions submitted that the petitioner would take a demand draft for a sum of Rs.25,000/-
favouring the Designated Officer, Food Safety Department, Theni and hand over the same to the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis second respondent.

Thereafter, the second respondent will in turn hand over the original demand draft to the Designated Officer and also submit his claim for reimbursement for the expenses incurred in connection with his trip to Haryana.

The Designated Officer shall reimburse Mr.A.Shanmugam and honour the bills submitted by him without any delay,
in any event, within a period of seven days, after the original demand draft is encashed.
I need not add that the question of second respondent making an independent claim before the Government will not arise.

3.Since the petitioner has undertaken to reimburse the expenses incurred by the second respondent,
the petitioner is directed to appear before the trial Magistrate on 04.12.2021 and apply for recall of warrant.
The learned trial Magistrate shall allow the recall petition and shall not remand the petitioner to custody.
4.The criminal original petition is allowed on these terms.
